title: Dham
desc: After Rushi changes his violent ways and helps four college friends resolve their problems, they decide to repay his kindness by reuniting him with his former girlfriend.

title: Villadhi Villain
desc: Meenatchi Sundara Sasthiriyaar, an eminent lawyer, is against the relationship of his daughter with Edison. When Edison is charged for the murder of a minister, he seeks Meenatchi's help.

title: Aattanayagann
desc: Lingam is shocked after his sister-in-law informs him that his brother, Chandran, is a dreaded gangster. To set things right, Lingam decides to reform his brother.

title: Arima Nambi
desc: Anamika gets mysteriously abducted while on a date with Arjun. However, when Arjun goes to the police for help, he lands in a dangerous situation.

title: Anjaneya
desc: A police officer goes undercover to infiltrate the mafia and collect incriminating evidence. During his operation, he receives assistance from Divya, who begins to have romantic feelings for him.
